model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 890 East 152nd Street in Cleveland, Ohio, as the Technical Sergeant Alma Gladys Minter Post Office Building.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Shontel Brown (D-OH)

summary.text: The bill would rename a Cleveland, Ohio post office building to honor Technical Sergeant Alma Gladys Minter.
